parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Hybrid Cloud WAF cluster.

> This parameter is available only in hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query Hybrid Cloud WAF clusters.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of detection statistics. Valid values:

- **risk**: statistics on security risks.

- **event**: statistics on attacks.

parameters.name: UserStatusList
parameters.description: The list of statuses used to filter the detection statistics.
